title: The 4 Best Blackout Curtains for Small Windows
h1: The 4 Best Blackout Curtains for Small Windows
metaDescription: Our 4 picks for blackout curtains for small windows, with key specs, strengths and limitations for each, based on manufacturer specs, independent reviews and owner reports.
lede: We looked at blackout curtains for small windows using manufacturer specs, independent reviews and owner reports. Each pick lists what it does well and where it falls short, so you can match it to how you'll use it.

products.name: Eclipse Darrell Rod Pocket Blackout Curtain Panel
products.blurb: Key specs: 37 x 84 inch single panel, rod pocket top, Thermaback blackout backing, Blocks over 99% of light.
strengths: 37-inch width is proportionally right for a narrow window, unlike bulkier 52-inch panels
Blocks over 99% of light, matching the wider Eclipse Palisade panel
Rod pocket top gives a traditional, gathered look that suits a small decorative window
limitations: Rod pocket top is slower to open and close than a grommet panel
84-inch length needs hemming for a shorter small window
features: 37 x 84 inch single panel, rod pocket top
Reduces noise and insulates against heat and cold

products.name: Sun Zero Easton Blackout Grommet Curtain Panel
products.blurb: Key specs: 40 x 63 inch single panel, grommet top, Blocks up to 90% of light, Reduces energy loss through the window by up to 25%.
strengths: 40-inch width is naturally suited to smaller windows without looking bulky
63-inch length fits a small window without hemming in many rooms
limitations: 90% blocking is lower than the Eclipse Darrell's 99%+ rate
Grommet-only, no rod pocket option in this line
features: 40 x 63 inch single panel, grommet top
Reduces energy loss through the window by up to 25%

products.name: Lush Decor Sheer Grommet Curtain with Insulated Blackout Lining
products.blurb: Key specs: 38 x 84 inch pair, Sheer face fabric with insulated blackout lining sewn in, Grommet top.
strengths: 38-inch width is a natural fit for a narrow window without overwhelming the frame
Sheer overlay adds a decorative daytime look uncommon in narrow blackout panels
Sewn-in lining means no separate liner to buy
limitations: Blocks somewhat less light than a solid laminated panel of the same width
Smaller ratings base than the more established brands in this list
features: Sheer face fabric with insulated blackout lining sewn in
Softer daytime look while still blocking light at night

products.name: Exclusive Home Curtains Gates Sateen Blackout Curtain Panel Pair
products.blurb: Key specs: 52 x 63 inch pair, 2 panels, 8 matte silver grommets per panel, Sateen twill weave with Light Block and Thermax lining.
strengths: 63-inch length matches many smaller, shorter windows without hemming
Sold as a pair, giving full coverage on a slightly wider small window
Sateen finish looks more polished than a plain utilitarian panel
limitations: 52-inch panel width is wider than ideal for a genuinely narrow window under 30 inches
Fewer total ratings than the Eclipse or Sun Zero lines
features: Sateen twill weave with Light Block and Thermax lining
Blocks light and blocks harmful UV rays

howWeChose: Picks are based on manufacturer specs, independent reviews and owner reports. We don't claim our own testing.
We do not list prices or star ratings because they change. Check Amazon for current details.
